task.title: Change the interface language
task.shortdesc: Select English, Russian, German, Simplified Chinese, French, Spanish, or the system language for BPM.

prereq.p: Open BPM in the browser and keep a profile, Library, All settings, Guided, JSON, or Compare surface available.

context.p: Use the language selector when screenshots, labels, validation messages, and documentation examples must match the operator locale.

step.cmd: Open the language selector in the page header.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Choose English, Russian, German, Simplified Chinese, French, Spanish, or System.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Confirm that navigation labels, validation messages, status text, and editor controls switch to the selected locale.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Continue editing only after confirming that the profile and schema channel are still the same.

info.note: Save or deliberately discard changes before leaving an editor, closing a tab, or confirming an irreversible action.

result.p: BPM displays the interface in the selected locale without changing profile data.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the visible state is unclear, stop editing, read the current status message, refresh once, and reopen the profile from the Library.
